title: Educational Technology
subtitle: Tools for teaching, learning, and events.
summary: Three tools built for the University of Houston: accessible course documents, AI-assisted grading, and a STEM event platform.
description: A collection of tools built for the University of Houston to save faculty and staff time, from making course materials accessible to grading at scale and running a STEM competition. Each one runs on AWS.

projects.title: PDF Accessibility
projects.summary: Turns course PDFs into WCAG 2.1 accessible documents. AI suggests alt text and document details, scanned pages are read with OCR, and a visual editor lets you check tags and reading order before downloading. Works on one file or a whole batch.

projects.title: Rubric Grader
projects.summary: Helps instructors grade consistently. Upload a blank assignment and the AI builds a rubric from it, then run a batch of student submissions, including handwritten work, against that rubric. Each is scored for how closely it matches, with results ready to export or send as student feedback.

projects.title: Mars Rover Celebration
projects.tagline: A STEM event, run end to end.
projects.summary: Registration and event management for the Mars Rover Celebration, a University of Houston STEM Center competition for elementary and middle school students. Teachers, students, and judges register online. On the day, a full admin panel handles check-in, judge assignments, and scoring, with live updates. In English and Spanish.
